text:
Maya: quick one from the quickstart walkthrough — users keep seeing a raw "500" toast when the model hiccups. No guidance, they hammer refresh and open tickets.

Arjun: is that hosted or Dedicated and do you have the exact body?

Maya: hosted. sometimes 503. body was basically `{'error': 'server error'}`. no structured fields.

Elaine: that explains why SDKs behave so differently. Go wraps into APIError, Python bubbles requests.HTTPError, JS throws fetch errors. We need a tiny canonical error contract so sample apps and SDKs behave consistently.

Sam: proposal (minimal): add these JSON fields on error: `code` (string), `message` (string), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after_ms` (int, optional), `user_hint` (short string), `client_notice` (stable key), `operation_id` (opaque). Example: `{"error": {"code": "model_overloaded", "message": "node overloaded", "retryable": true, "retry_after_ms": 8000, "user_hint": "Try again in a few seconds.", "client_notice": "TOAST_RETRY_SHORT", "operation_id": "op_abc123"}}`. SDKs can parse that reliably.

Zoe: small addition: add `debug_hint` field that stays out of user UI but is logged to Sentry. Also prefer `retry_after_ms` over Retry-After header because proxies/HTTP-date parsing are flaky.

Arjun: agree. Also we must avoid surprising auto-retries. SDKs should NOT auto-retry non-idempotent endpoints by default, even if `retryable=true`. Add `idempotency` metadata per endpoint in OpenAPI and expose a client helper `with_retries()` that the app opts into.

Elaine: SDK surface: typed exception (RedwoodAPIError) with properties `.code`, `.retryable`, `.retry_after_ms`, `.operation_id`, `.client_notice`, `.user_hint`, `.debug_hint`, and helpers `.is_retryable()` and `.suggested_backoff_ms()`. Also generate an enum for common codes (model_overloaded, model_timeout, rate_limit, validation_error) so language clients can switch on stable values.

Sam: docs should include a tiny mapping table in onboarding: 4xx (except 429/422) -> client error no retry; 422 -> validation (show field errors); 429 -> rate limit (honor retry_after or backoff); 5xx/503/model_overloaded -> transient (retryable by default but SDK checks idempotency). We'll add example JSON for each.

Maya: sampleapp UX: show `user_hint` in toast with a countdown if `retry_after_ms` present and a Retry button. If endpoint is non-idempotent, clicking Retry should show a confirmation modal: "This may duplicate the action. Continue?" Also include a small "Report" link that attaches `operation_id` to support.

Arjun: infra note: emit the JSON fields behind a feature flag initially and continue to send legacy freeform message for a grace period. We'll coordinate rollout and codegen updates for clients.

Zoe: observability: always tag `operation_id` and `error.code` in Sentry/metrics and emit histogram of `retry_after_ms` so infra can tune backpressure.

CI-bot: CI triggered for branch `maya/error-ux-contract` — smoke tests queued.

Sam: i'll open the SDK parity ticket for Python + JS and include example snippets showing opt-in retries and manual handling. Example snippet: `try: client.create(...)
except RedwoodAPIError as e:
  ui.show(e.user_hint)
  if e.retryable and client.is_idempotent('create'):
    show_retry_button()`

Elaine: final ask: separate `user_hint` (1-2 sentences) from `debug_hint` so UIs never surface internal troubleshooting text. Add `client_notice` keys for i18n mapping.

Maya: thanks all — i'll open the sampleapp PR with screenshots and wire up the report link. Posting RFC once Arjun drafts. Keep replies here for quick sync. :thumbsup:
